description: Small-business action guidance for proactive honeypot CTI. Rules are human-curated from cited trusted sources and should not be labeled as generated intelligence.
limitations: This policy turns honeypot evidence into prioritized guidance for non-specialist operators.
It does not prove that a production host was compromised.
Predicted next steps are likely or possible hypotheses and should be verified against real logs before major remediation.

actions.why: Tor and VPN sources can rotate quickly, so behavior and fingerprints are more durable than a single IP.
